purpose: Ranking/localization checks on publicly awarded text, an author-described blank strip, and a matched depth-shuffle process control. No candidate gate or estimated population false-positive rate.
freeze_scope: Selected from source metadata before image pixels were downloaded and before any new line-ranker or glyph outputs.

cases.raw_render_frame: x=(u+36)*K; y=(v+21)*K; K=1000/8.64; crop then flip vertically to reading orientation
cases.score: Exact released fwd_prod float16 promoted to float32; TRACE_v3B times mean A-hn probabilities; no stretch
cases.validity: Public CT surface layer20 >0 in the same source crop; a tissue-support proxy, not independent acquisition coverage
cases.row_box_rule: Use claim x-bounds inset8 source pixels and row centre +/-2mm; convert from published image panel to source reading crop; this is a coarse line-localization target, not a per-pixel text label

cases.label_limit: Chosen in advance by original authors; not an independently annotated or representative text-free population

cases.score: Exact released shuf_prod float16 promoted to float32; same crop, orientation and CT-support proxy
cases.label_limit: Corrupted-input output, not a physical blank sheet; failures/successes cannot establish empirical false-positive bounds

cases.score: clip((R-B)/(135*0.9),0,1), recovering normalized displayed yellow opacity only, not original model probabilities
cases.validity: RGB pixel nonblack and compatible with grey+yellow mixture: abs((R-G)-(20/135)*(R-B))<=2.0; excludes cyan baseline annotation and unrelated colors; this is a display-content mask
cases.targets: All18 published letters_area_px boxes grouped into2 rows; no new boxes selected from ranking outputs

reporting.localization: Report coarse row-box overlap and separately fraction of each published343 letter box covered by proposals; do not count unlabelled remainder as known negative
reporting.thresholds: Ranker thresholds fixed by separate method protocol, not fit on these controls
reporting.training_overlap: Unknown for glyphCNN; these public controls may overlap its training and are therefore implementation/sensitivity checks only
